answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing. The raven holds work receipts rather than names, so the kernel of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The yarrow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
